title: Custom Semi Truck with American Flag Background Comforter
description:
Transform your bedroom into a tribute to the open road with this custom patriotic trucker comforter set from Jeminise. Featuring a bold semi truck design set against an American flag background under a starry night sky, this high-quality bedding is the perfect gift for professional drivers, truck enthusiasts, and patriotic families alike. Add a custom name to create a truly unique and meaningful personalized bedding piece.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize this patriotic bedding with a name of your choice to make a thoughtful, one-of-a-kind gift.
  • Patriotic Trucking Theme: Features a beautifully rendered digital illustration of a semi truck with an American flag and night sky stars.
  • Premium Fabric Material: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric that is lightweight, breathable, and incredibly soft to the touch.
  • Durability & Comfort: Uses advanced eco-friendly printing techniques to prevent colors from fading, along with smooth, compact stitching along the edges.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; air dry or tumble dry on low heat to keep the microfiber fluffy and vibrant.
  • Included Components: Your package includes one customized comforter (or duvet cover) with optional matching pillowcases and flat sheets.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Selected Design Flag Trucker
Theme Trucker
Style Modern
Pattern Cartoon
Available Sizes Twin, Full, Queen, King
Care Instructions Machine Wash
